facts.text: WWU's Fairhaven College does not use the A-to-F grading system, utilizing student self-evaluations and faculty narrative assessments instead.

sources.title: Fairhaven Narrative Evaluations | Fairhaven College of Interdisciplinary Studies | Western Washington University
sources.quote: Fairhaven College classes do not use the A-to-F grading system. Students evaluate their own performance in detail for each Fairhaven college course.
